lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Heat. Real heat, pressing against exposed skin. The air tastes like metal and effort.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.lens: Temperature spike. Localized — centered on a stone column ahead. No fire visible. The heat is coming from inside the stone itself. Structural integrity holding. Barely.

lines.speaker: Rynn
lines.monologue: Her hand moves to her pack strap. Not her weapon. Her pack. She's calculating whether to fight or run. She always decides that first.

lines.speaker: Lex
lines.text: Varek. Power and intensity. The texts called it the honest god — it doesn't hide what it is. Or what it wants from you.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The shrine is a cracked stone column, dark red light bleeding from the fractures. It radiates the way a furnace does — not inviting, but not deceptive. This is what I am. Come closer or don't.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.monologue: I respect this. No games. No mystery. Just force, clearly stated. There's something clean about that. Dangerous, but clean.

lines.speaker: Caelan
lines.text: It's not hostile. It's just... intense.
lines.monologue: Like standing next to someone who's always running at full capacity. Exhausting to be near. Impossible to ignore.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The heat holds steady. The shrine doesn't test or tempt. It simply is what it is, and it waits to see if you are what you are.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Something is placed at the column's base. The cracks flare — bright, brief, honest — and something is given back: not power, but clarity. A moment of knowing exactly what you're capable of. No more, no less. The truth of your own limits, offered without cruelty.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.monologue: I know what I can do. I always have. But knowing it and having it confirmed by something that doesn't care about you are two different things. The second one is harder to argue with.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The heat recedes. The red light dims to a faint glow. Varek has no use for lingering.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: They step back. The heat doesn't follow. Varek doesn't chase.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.monologue: I don't look back. Not because I'm afraid. Because the shrine already showed me everything it was going to show me, and staring at it won't add anything.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The column continues to bleed light into the dark. It will burn until the stone gives out, and then it will stop. No ceremony. No fading. Just done.
